releaseNotes: ACCOUNT SWITCHING IS NOW A VISIBLE BUTTON — no hidden gesture needed. Tap your profile tab (bottom-right) like normal: when the panel with Quests / Shop / Settings opens, an Ophelia 'Switch Accounts' row sits right above Quests. Tap it to save and switch between accounts. (Holding your profile tab still opens the full quick menu with status + accounts.)

ONE-TAP CLONE UPDATES — no more re-cloning to get a fix. Whenever Deadlock Studio ships a switcher bug-fix OR the Discord app itself gets updated on your phone, an 'Update this clone' button appears right under Switch Accounts in your profile panel (and at the top of the hold-menu). One tap, Clone by Ophelia re-patches that clone in place — same identity, same key, your logins and data stay exactly as they are.
The update check is fully silent: it runs in the background once every 6 hours and only shows the button when there is actually something newer. No notifications, no nagging, nothing breaks offline.
Updated clones keep everything: accounts saved in the switcher, Discord logins, settings, chats cache.
The cloner app itself now signs releases with both v1+v2 schemes (same certificate — installs as a normal update; this fixes 'there was a problem parsing the package' on some phones).
switcherReleaseNotes: New: 'Switch Accounts' + 'Update this clone' rows injected above the Quests row of Discord's own profile panel (matches the panel's theme, light or dark).
New: in-clone update center — compares the release feed's switcherVersion and the installed original Discord's versionCode, and hands an in-place re-patch request to the cloner app.
New: self-healing fallback pill if the host app's layout leaves the injected row unmeasured.
